_source: See .claude/skills/jyotish-engine/references/constants.md for full reasoning and caveats. Rahu/Ketu exaltation is genuinely disputed across traditions -- do not treat the values below as settled; they are the commonly-cited convention and must be surfaced as configurable.
_zoneNote: For 5 of 7 planets, the exaltation sign never overlaps their own/moolatrikona sign, so the WHOLE sign counts as 'exalted' dignity (the exact degree only sharpens graded strength, not the categorical dignity). Moon (Taurus) and Mercury (Virgo) are exceptions -- BPHS Ch.3 v51 and v53 explicitly bound their exaltation to a narrow zone because the same sign also hosts moolatrikona (and, for Mercury, own sign too). 'zoneEndDegree' is set only for these two; its absence means 'whole sign counts as exalted.' Verified against BPHS primary text (archive.org/stream/BPHSEnglish), not a secondary-source assumption.

Rahu.note: Some traditions use Gemini instead. Make configurable.

Ketu.note: Some traditions use Sagittarius instead. Make configurable.

debilitation._rule: Always the sign opposite exaltation, at the same degree.

Moon._verified: BPHS Ch.3 v51: 'after the first 3 degrees of exaltation portion in Taurus, for the Moon the rest is her moolatrikona' -- exact primary-source quote, not a secondary-source estimate.

Mercury._verified: BPHS Ch.3 v53: 'first 15 degrees exaltation zone, next 5 degrees moolatrikona, last 10 degrees own house' -- exact primary-source quote.

naturalFriendships._note: Asymmetric by design -- e.g. Sun treats Mercury as neutral, but Mercury treats Sun as a friend. This is correct, not a bug.
